title: Repeated Lateness Rule — LandlordGuard Late Fee Multiplier
content:
**Rule.** On the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy the repeat factor of a late fee depends on the late fees already posted on the policy in the 24 calendar months up to the charge date: two or more multiply the fee by 2; exactly one multiplies it by 1.5; none leaves it as it stands.

The repeat factor multiplies the late fee as a whole, that is the late-fee basis together with the late-fee adjustment, before the fee is rounded.

| Late fees already posted on the policy, 24 calendar months up to the charge date | Repeat factor |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | multiplied by 2 |
| exactly 1 | multiplied by 1.5 |
| none | as it stands |

## Counting

- Only late-fee entries on this policy's premium account count, each by the date it was posted.
- The fee being charged is not one of the fees already posted.

## Hypothetical cases

| Earlier late fees on the account | Repeat factor | A late fee of 12.50 USD before the repeat factor becomes |
|---|---|---|
| posted 5 and 22 months before the charge date | multiplied by 2 | 25.00 USD |
| posted 5 and 26 months before the charge date | multiplied by 1.5 | 18.75 USD |
| none | as it stands | 12.50 USD |
